description: UCI output parsing, shared by the analysis service (M4) and the desktop engine manager (M3). Each `info` case gives a raw line, the side to move of the searched position, and the parsed line with scores already turned to White's view (ENGINE.md). `expect: null` means the line is not shown: no pv, a bound score, `info string`, or a currmove report. `multipv` defaults to 1 when the engine leaves it out; `wdl` is absent when the engine does not send it.
